decisions.reason: Confirming the competitor design-reference URL does not change the Shatter House brand name or Ridgehaven brand identity.
The confirmed URL is a design reference, not a replacement for the master website domain or its routing.
Identifying the competitor design-reference URL does not alter support for additional locations or the consistent location-template strategy.
The design-reference confirmation does not change the requirement to list locations and provide sublinks from the master site.
The competitor design-reference URL has no effect on separate revenue and sales tracking for each location.
The competitor design-reference URL has no effect on separate booking management for each location.
